report_name: Critical RCE Flaw in OpenWrt Allows Root Access via DHCPv6

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-53921
vulnerabilities.description: A critical unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE) vulnerability in the DHCPv6 server component (odhcpd) of OpenWrt. An attacker on the same network segment can send a specially crafted DHCPv6 packet to trigger the flaw and execute arbitrary code with root privileges.

indicators.name: OpenWrt odhcpd Process Crash
indicators.pattern:
title: OpenWrt odhcpd Process Crash
id: 7b9e1d4a-3c2f-4b1a-8d5c-6e7f8a9b0c1d
status: experimental
description: Detects crashes or unexpected restarts of the odhcpd process on OpenWrt devices, which could indicate exploitation of CVE-2026-53921.
references:
  - https://techmaniacs.com/2026/07/29/cybersecurity-daily-briefing-july-29-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-30
tags:
  - attack.t1210
  - attack.execution
level: high
logsource:
  product: linux
  service: systemd
detection:
  selection_process:
    keywords:
      - 'odhcpd'
  selection_crash:
    keywords:
      - 'crashed'
      - 'segmentation fault'
  condition: selection_process and selection_crash
indicators.description: Detects crashes or unexpected restarts of the odhcpd process on OpenWrt devices, which could indicate exploitation of CVE-2026-53921.

indicators.name: OpenWrt Version Check Command
indicators.pattern:
title: OpenWrt Version Check Command
id: 8c0f2e5b-4d3a-4c2b-9e6d-7f8a9b0c1d2e
status: experimental
description: Detects the execution of a command used to check the installed OpenWrt version. This may be used by administrators for patching or by attackers during reconnaissance.
references:
  - https://techmaniacs.com/2026/07/29/cybersecurity-daily-briefing-july-29-2026/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-07-30
tags:
  - attack.t1082
  - attack.discovery
level: informational
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: linux
detection:
  selection:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'opkg list-installed'
      - 'grep openwrt-release'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects the execution of a command used to check the installed OpenWrt version. This may be used by administrators for patching or by attackers during reconnaissance.
